query: New session. The plan docs/plans/06-rerun-agent.md is approved (multi-agent, groups G1 server, then G2 client and G3 e2e in parallel) and implements specs/10-rerun-agent.md. Continue the feature: describe exactly which agents you start, in which order, and what you put in each prompt.
expected_behavior: Runs the pre-flight first: plan Status approved, check-plan.mjs, dependencies installed, Postgres only if the plan needs it, notes the merge-base as base
Starts one fresh implementer per group with the plan path, the group id and the previous handoff; G2 and G3 go out in one message; never pastes the plan or a diff into a prompt

After the last group starts architecture-reviewer and pr-skill-reviewer in correctness mode in ONE message, with the fields from handoffs.md; does NOT start test-writer (tests are off by default) and says so in the closing report; the correctness file list excludes tests and generated files
Merges architecture CRITICAL and WARNING findings with in_change true and correctness findings into one fix-mode implementer, then rechecks architecture (up to 3 rounds); does not edit code itself
Runs implementation-verifier only after the fix pass, then security-reviewer on PASS, then doc-writer, and tells the user to run /pr-self-review instead of starting it

query: The user says: "the spec specs/10-rerun-agent.md looks mostly fine, let's plan it". The spec file says Status: draft and has OQ-2 with no answer. What do you do?
expected_behavior: Does not start brainstorm or implementation-planner on a draft spec
Does not write Status: approved from 'looks mostly fine': asks for an explicit approval of that file
Raises OQ-2 with the user (numbered options) and routes the answer to spec-creator before approval
Names the next stage after approval: brainstorm with the spec path

query: implementation-verifier returned FAIL with three 'To reach PASS' lines (AC-4, EC-2, S5.done). A fix-mode implementer fixed them; the verifier was re-run and still reports AC-4 not met. A second fix round also leaves AC-4 not met: the implementer reports that AC-4 contradicts AC-1. What now?
expected_behavior: Re-runs the verifier with recheck: and the item ids, not a full verification
Stops after the second failed round instead of starting a third

Recognises a contradiction between criteria as a spec gap: the user decides, then spec-creator amends the approved spec (reopened as draft, new or reworded id, Amended line), the user approves again, the planner updates the plan
Does not reword the spec, the plan or the code itself
